values.name: score
values.label: Human job rating
values.description:
The human's integer rating of delivered work. 5 — Excellent: delivered what I wanted; nothing to correct.
4 — Good: minor corrections only; no rework.
3 — Flawed: usable, but it cost me effort it should not have.
2 — Poor: substantial rework, or pieces missing.
1 — Unusable: I would have been faster doing it myself.
Investigate at score <= 3. No answer or cancellation means no metric row, never zero.
